name: structural-stream-dispatch-render-function-reconciliation
body: `solution.component.structural-stream-dispatch` is implemented-by `rust.apg.available_languages`, `rust.apg.frontend_cmd`, `rust.apg.spawn_frontend`, `rust.apg.ingest.ingest_records`, `rust.apg.ingest.root_module_fqn`, and `rust.apg.classify.builtin_code_type`. The structural streams emit their declarations as `Struct` records — the component streams `File`/`Struct`/`contains` records, each format emitter turns a parsed file into the format's `Struct`/`contains` records (shell functions included), and `requirements.requirement.structural-format-structure` names them as graph nodes under the format's `lang_switch` id. `rust.apg.ingest.render_function_fqns` renders Function declarations only: it takes `&[FuncDecl]` and maps unique declarations to `parent.name` and overloaded declarations to `parent.name(T1,T2,...)`, with Go `init#<file-basename>` and the py same-scope duplicate rule.
